title: Lighthouse Insights — prospect pulse & outbound scratchpad
body:
High level intent:
- Explore strategic integration: Lighthouse Insights (retail analytics) + Redwood inference for real-time shopper-personalization engine.
- Primary ask: pilot on Dedicated for low-latency inference + token-cost optimization via Redwood Optimize.

Quick account snapshot:
- HQ: Seattle; ~120 employees; Series B 2023; strong retail clients (mid-market chains).
- Product: event-stream analytics, store-matching, SKU affinity models. Looking to add on-device-like personalization without investing infra.
- Recent signals: job postings for ML infra engineer (hiring), blog post about latency problems during peak traffic (Nov 2025).

Key contacts (from LinkedIn + outreach):
- Priya Desai — Head of Data Platforms (DM, likely budget holder).
- Tom Hsu — Sr. ML Engineer (technical champion).
- Erin Morales — VP Products (influencer for roadmap).
- Unknown: procurement/legal (TBD after product fit).

Pain points / triggers:
- 95th percentile latency spikes during hourly peak (reported by blog).
- Cost creep from over-provisioned GPU clusters for infrequent spikes.
- Need for predictable latency SLAs for retail partners; hesitation to host models externally without guarantees.

Why Redwood is relevant (value props to highlight):
- Dedicated pools for predictable throughput + SLA (speaks to latency ask).
- Smart routing + fallback reduces tail risk during peaks.
- Optimize (batching/caching/quantization) can reduce token spend vs naive hosting.
- Private deployment option addresses compliance/data residency concerns for some retail partners.

Outbound cadence (first draft):
- Day 0: short email to Priya — subject: "Latency & cost pilot idea for Lighthouse Insights" — 3 line intro, 1 metric (avg 95th p spike), ask for 20–30m to show config that cuts cost x2 and keeps 95th under target.
- Day 3: LinkedIn note + Tom Hsu (technical note + one slide)
- Day 7: one-pager + suggested pilot plan (1 week smoke test on Dedicated dev pool) to Erin (product).
- Day 14: call to action, propose joint tech sync + short demo.

Draft outreach blurb (email):
"Hi Priya — saw Lighthouse’s post about latency under peak traffic. We run a developer-first inference platform used by retail teams to get consistent 95th-p latency at a lower token cost. I have a concrete pilot plan (1-week smoke test, telemetry + cost delta) that we can run on Dedicated with optional private control plane. 20–30m to walk through? — Jordan"

Objection handling (short riffs):
- "We can manage infra ourselves": acknowledge, then focus on dev time saved + predictable economics + rollout tooling (A/B, canary fallback). Offer TCO comparison for current infra vs Redwood Dedicated (real numbers).
- "Security/compliance concerns": point to Private deployment + KMS/HSM integrations and audit logs. Offer SRE checklist + SOC/ISO artifacts (send after NDA).
- "Lock-in worries": emphasize model-agnostic API, rollbacks, ability to pin versions and migrate model weights. Contract language: exit entitlements for model artifacts.

Pilot proposal (sketch):
- Goal: prove 95th-p latency target under production-like load and show >=30% reduction in per-token cost.
- Scope: 1 model (candidate in-house transformer), 2 test stores, pre-recorded traffic + 2h live window.
- Duration: 1 week (3 days setup + 2 days run + 2 days analysis).
- Success metrics: 95th-p latency < 200ms, cost/unit delta, error rates comparable to baseline.

Open questions / research TODOs:
- Do they use quantized weights today? (ask Tom)
- Who signs NDAs / procurement thresholds? (ask Erin)
- Confirm current infra costs (approx monthly GPU spend) — estimate from job posts / Glassdoor?
- Check for partner references who used Dedicated before (legal/refs).

Immediate next steps (this week):
- Finalize one-pager (Maya) by Tue 2026-03-05.
- Send intro email to Priya + copy Tom (Jordan) by Wed 2026-03-06.
- Prep short demo script and slide (Liam) — include cost delta mock numbers and simple latency graph.

Notes to self:
- Keep outreach light, data-first. Avoid heavy product jargon on first touch.
- If no reply in 7 days, pivot to a technical note with a short perf-run gif and a link to a reproducible benchmark repo (lightweight).
- Save case study template if pilot wins — focus on retail-specific metrics (conversion bump, latency impact during promos).

Reference links to assemble:
- internal perf benchmarks: confluence/perf/dedicated-retail-case-study (ask infra team for access)
- sample pilot contract template: https://legal.redwood.ai/templates/pilot-nda-v2

End of scratchpad — keep rough, will iterate after first outreach.
